audit.why: FAV at 4/10 matches a 56.11% win rate over 647 games; early lane is Gangplank's, late is Nasus's, and the text already says so.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5] / win[5] (First item) were set to 'Skill' while the packet chart and whys[5] both make the Sheen spike Gangplank's.
audit.why: whys[5] states the empowered Parrrley detonating a chained keg bursts a still-low-stack Nasus. That is a Gangplank-favoured stage, and the packet levelChart agrees.
audit.corrected: First item = Gangplank 7/10. Level 6 and 2+ items unchanged; 2+ items stays Nasus, matching the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places say Wither is cleansed 'with Q'. Gangplank's Q is Parrrley, a ranged shot; the cleanse is Remove Scurvy (W), 22/20/18/16/14. Two real interactions were also absent: Fury of the Sands does max-Health damage so armour is not the answer, and Siphoning Strike is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot text: W 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health.' Q only 'Shoots target'. Nasus R flags percentHealth; Nasus Q flags autoReset. Telling the player to cleanse a 15s Wither with a 4.5s pistol shot is advice that simply does not function.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy (W) cures Wither; Fury of the Sands burns through resistances; step back on his auto wind-up because Siphoning Strike resets the attack and lands before any cast tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wither's cooldown was never stated despite the whole entry being built around tracking it.
audit.why: 15/14/13/12/11 is the punish window; a real number makes 'engage when it is down' actionable.
audit.corrected: Wither 15s at rank 1 added to the cooldown breakdown and the interactions report line.

audit.why: Win condition (snowball the mid window, end before stacks) and Nasus's (free-stack, reach 2 items) are both stated clearly and agree with the mirror.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are roughly even because your barrels aren't fully online and Nasus only wants to farm — but he has to walk into melee range to last-hit Siphoning Strike, and that step-up is free Parrrley harass. Don't dump E barrels here; their cooldown is long early and he'll just path around them. Pistol him every time he reaches for a stack, respect that his level 1 auto-and-Q poke is real, and don't get baited into extended auto trades where his stacked Q hurts.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are roughly even because your barrels aren't fully online and Nasus only wants to farm — but he has to walk into 255-range melee to last-hit Siphoning Strike, and that step-up is free Parrrley harass. Don't dump E barrels here; their cooldown is long early and he'll just path around them. Pistol him every time he reaches for a stack, and back off on his auto wind-up: Siphoning Strike is an auto reset, so the swing lands before any cast tell.

notes: The recurring 'Cleanse it with Q' line was the real defect here and the packet's scan reported zero defects for this matchup — it fabricates a function Parrrley does not have. Remove Scurvy (W) is the cleanse. Mirror (nasus__gangplank.json) is consistent with everything above: 2+ items stays Nasus's stage on both sides.
